packageRules.description: Dev dependencies: group patch and minor. Auto-merge stays off until the Phase 2 CI smoke test is green and in required checks.
Runtime dependencies ship to users; group them but always review by hand.
Majors land one at a time so a failure is attributable.
Drizzle tracks a release candidate; orm and kit must move together.
OpenCode is slated for replacement; let its SDK settle before adopting, and update the documented minimum version in the same PR.
Node types must stay on the supported major, never follow the current release.
Keep Tailwind and its Vite integration aligned.
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs for supply-chain integrity.

The Dockerfile pins its base image by digest as well as by tag, so without this the pin would never be refreshed and the image would ship whatever CVEs the base had on the day it was written. The rule above is scoped to github-actions only.

A digest bump is the same Node on a rebuilt base and lands as an ordinary PR. A version bump is not: the base image is pinned to the floor in engines.node, and moving it alone would ship users a runtime nothing in CI ran. Approve one only together with engines.node and .nvmrc.
